comments.body: I reported the discovery and got this map a second time but when I digged it I only got the discovery again, no Jewellery box. Is it the same with all the maps, you only get the reward the first time? Or perhaps i did something wrong...

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: Did you have the original reward item in your inventory/bank vault/quarters storage? That sometimes interferes with the process. I've also been told some map items only drop again very rarely... and then there are the items which only drop once per character, ever. I dunno which category this item would fall under, sorry.

comments.author: Iago_Moor
comments.body:
It *seems* to me that maps that give an equipment item are non-item-repeatable whereas those that give consumables/trade goods are. For instance, [ID=01900001] gets you the clothes only once (confirmed by me), whereas [ID=01900369] will give you mtt every time.

I have yet to see a map that is non-repeatable, ie that you cannot pull from archives again.
